note: Gap slice g01. Kept 32, skipped 6. LAWES: the four-viol Royall Consort is entered per the brief's several-scorings rule (Phantasm, Linn CKD 470, 2015, all ten Setts, theorbo kept as 'lute'); keys copied from the six-part entries (Phantasm labels them only 'in D', 'in A' ...), which I take to be the same music; durations are Phantasm's. The four-viol-and-theorbo scoring and 'first complete recording' come from a web-search summary of the Linn/Gramophone/Presto pages (they returned 403 or timed out when opened); the track lists are from Deezer. BYRD: the Ground a 5 is a consort piece (Phantasm, Fretwork, Parley of Instruments, Kuijken); no IMSLP page of its own found and no T number confirmed, so the title has none; the duration is blank because recordings give one timing for Prelude and Ground together (5:39). SCHEIN: 4 and 5 are on Collegium Terpsichore's Tanzmusik um 1600 (Favorit 447 680-2), which labels Suite 4 'in D' and Suite 3 'in A' against IMSLP's G and E minor (MusicBrainz links them to IMSLP's numbers); Suite 4 is therefore confidence low. Suites 9, 11, 12 and 17: I could not find a recording, only the Pavans of 12 and 17 as interludes on Psalmen Davids (1996); the GAPS note says the fact-checkers found them recorded, so the owner may have a source I lack. TITZ: Profil Vol. 3 lists a 'No. 1 in C major' of only two movements (Allegro, Rondo) under the title of the three-quartet set; Vols 1-3 hold Op. 1 Nos. 2-6 and the six quartets of the two three-quartet sets, so the leftover C-major quartet is Op. 1 No. 1 by elimination; streaming metadata is not conclusive. PETER: New World 80507-2 records all six quintets (keys from its track list); no timings found, so minutes are blank. KIRNBERGER: this Trio in D minor was parked on 2026-10-17 (parked-low-confidence.json) because one source attributes it to Handel (HWV Anh. B 427); kept here at confidence low because the gap list names it; the owner can drop it. NAUDOT: Nos. 4 and 6 are recorded on hurdy-gurdy and musette; the print allows flute, so they are entered as flute like Nos. 1, 3 and 5 (hurdy-gurdy and musette are not instrument keys). EBERL: no recording of the piano quartets Op. 18 and Op. 25 on MusicBrainz, Deezer or the web; skipped. SAMMARTINI: No. 6 is D minor in IMSLP's list and on Matteoli's NAR disc; Tactus lists it as D major (same four movements); duration 8 min is between the two recordings (7:03 and 9:27).
